department: School of Chemical and Biomolecular Engineering

deadline.value: Final date to apply is 11 December 2026; admissions are rolling, so apply early.
deadline.quote: The final date to submit an application is December 11, 2026. We strongly encourage early submission, as admissions are made on a rolling basis.

gre_general.value: ChBE does not use or accept GRE scores.
gre_general.quote: Note that we do not use the GRE in our admissions process.

also.quote: No, in fact the department no longer accepts GRE scores in the application process.

gre_subject.value: There is no GRE Subject test for chemical engineering; ChBE does not use the GRE at all.

supervisor.value: You apply to the school, not to a faculty member; an admissions committee decides and you choose a research advisor after meeting faculty once enrolled.
supervisor.quote: You must apply to the School, and not to a specific faculty member prior to your making a full application online. Decisions regarding admission are made by an Admissions Committee and are based on many factors. Upon entering our graduate program, you will be given an opportunity to choose a research advisor after meeting with a number of faculty members.

funding.value: Graduate assistantships covering tuition and fees plus a stipend are available to all qualified admitted PhD students.
funding.quote: Financial aid in the form of Graduate Assistantships is available to all qualified students who are admitted to our PhD programs. The Assistantships will cover tuition and fees and will provide a competitive stipend.

entry_route.value: A BS (or equivalent) in chemical engineering, bioengineering or a close field with a 3.3/4.0 GPA is the minimum.
entry_route.quote: In general, the minimum qualifications required are a BS degree (or equivalent) in Chemical Engineering, Bioengineering, Paper Science and Engineering, or a closely related field with a GPA of 3.3/4.0.

notes: Only TOEFL or IELTS Academic accepted (Institute minimums); take tests at least 60 days before the deadline.
